records.issue_text: [Low/bug] embeddable_hosts_controller.rb:26 silently coerces blank `category_id` to the uncategorized category, but an invalid (nonexistent) category_id from a tampered client fails with a DB foreign-key-style error instead of a clean message — validate the category exists
records.rationale: The diff's save_host in embeddable_hosts_controller.rb sets host.category_id directly from params[:embeddable_host][:category_id] with only a blank coercion to uncategorized, and the new EmbeddableHost model has no validation that the category exists. A nonexistent category_id would fail at the DB level with an unhandled error instead of a clean validation message. Impact is limited (admin/staff-only endpoint per before_filter), so severity is low, but the mechanism is verifiable in the diff.
